notes.title: CUCKOLD SIMULATOR 0.10.0 Update
notes.content:
CUCKOLD SIMULATOR's super big 0.10.0 update is here. Please read this in it's entirety, thanks.

Save Data Loss

The reference database for the save system was corrupted at some point since the last patch, and I wasn't able to restore it from backup. I rebuilt the database, but in doing so, Unity generates new reference IDs for everything. This means that old save files will no longer work. You will have to restart from Day 1. Have fun. ːTyroneSmugː

As compensation, those effected will find a Very Cool Hat added to their inventory upon starting a new game. I've also called in a few favors to help you along the way, so some story events may play out differently.

"New" Save System
 Unneeded references purged, save file size reduced by 80%. Hopefully reduces corruption issues.
 Backup system implemented, will attempt to roll back to previous save if corruption detected.
 Compensation event added for when the save and backup save are both corrupted.

New Content
 Next part of Tyrone main story line added.
 Next two parts of Wayne quest line added. 
 First two parts of The Dong quest line added.
 DeShawn dancing side-quest line added.
 Wayne drone side-quest line added.
 Smoke Detector side-quest line added.
 Emote system added on hotkey [X]. Find new emotes via quests and exploration.
 A gender neutral restroom has been added to GloboCorp.
 Fed Encounter event re-added. Matrix funky pop attainable again. 
 One new Funky Pop (Polychromatic) has been added. There are now 15, which is a full shelf!
 New achievements added: Never Forget, Terminated, Eyes In The Sky, Beer Exploit, Corrupted, Night Duty, Demon, No Call No Show, The Pact, Strange Device, The Great Escape
 Many new items added: Butt Light, Lambright Dimensional Navigator, Very Cool Hat, Spray Paint, Drone, and more.
 Korean Meme War rewards have been distributed. 
 Item categories overhauled and make sense now. Some items re-categorized.
 New 'decorations' added to GameStart.
 Cuckold has a cool new running animation.
 Various portal related sequence break events have been added.
 [strike]Various hidden areas added, such as ███████████ and ████.[/strike] This is a lie.
 Lots of other stuff I forgot to write down.

Bug Fixes/Miscellaneous
 Story based events will now trigger without requiring a game restart.
 Anime Girl Genocide chapter 2 intro scene no longer has a black screen when transitioning directly from chapter 1.
 Cuck Souls mouse movement improved through implementation of framerate cap (144).
 Selfie mode bug where an unequipped outfit was still being displayed has been fixed.
 Art Gallery event bug fix.
 Screen glitch effect added when near Federal Agents.
 Tyrone's skin has been made slightly darker. 
 Added new Tyrone animation after being kicked out of the bedroom during intro scene.
 Red Rocket achievement has been fixed (again) and is now attainable.
 Global lighting will no longer be overblown after loading police station.
 Chinatown Bar lighting has been improved.
 Cuckold now has a phone in hand when taking selfies.
 Changed color of unequipped items from blue to gray. Equipped items are still green.
 Save corrupting "hero shield" bugged item should no longer appear.
 Bugged Korean texts mostly reverted back to English. 
 TV Stream has been updated.
 Reporter now has blue hair.
 New animations for Wayne.
 Bed dialog now appears without needing an extra click.
 Lazy backup fading method for the Day/Night transition black screen in case it gets stuck.
 Game engine upgrade 2019.4.28f1 -> 2019.4.40f1
 Various other bugfixes.

Other
 Price decreased to $3.95.
Have you wishlisted TYRONE SOULZ yet?

notes.title: CUCKOLD SIMULATOR 0.4.0 Update
notes.content:
CUCKOLD SIMULATOR's long awaited 0.4.0 update is finally here. The more astute among you might notice that 0.3.0 has been skipped - that is intentional since this is by far the largest update to date. You should delete your old save data and start from the beginning, both to avoid bugs since a lot of things were changed, but also see some of the new content.


Major New Content

 Tyrone's Blicky has been added, along with a special event on Night 7. You'll want to restart your game to experience this one...
 Next phase of the Main Story has been added, along with two new areas.
 Wayne has moved into the neighborhood. Go have a neighborly chat with him. 
 Inventory System has been added (see below for more info).
 Anime Girl Genocide Chapter 2 has been added. This should be very exciting for all three of you who care about this subgame.
 9 new achievements added: Genocide But Faster, My Masterpiece, The Heist, Makin' Bacon, Pig Roast, Making a Mess, Betrayal, Paid in Full, System Error.

Inventory System

New inventory system has been added. Press B to open it. Cuckold many now collect many cool items in the world, including wearable cosmetics, such as the following:

 COVID Mask: DLC item.
 Top Hat: Located in a most fitting place.
 SNEED Hat: Two methods to get this - both require out-of-game file editing.
 Genocider's Halo: Complete Cuck Souls.
 Genocider's Wings: Complete Cuck Souls without taking any damage.

Not-So-Major New Features

 One new Funky Pop added (total of 9 now).
 Toggle option added for mouse y-axis input.
 Cuckold now wears actual glasses instead of sunglasses (might revert this)
 A new product has launched in ChinaTown and is available in select vending machines. How exciting! Time to consume!
 ATMs have been added in various parts of the world.
 An awful world map has been added. Press M to open it.
 New cinematic intro for GloboCorp the first time you go to work.
 Stats System has been added, but it doesn't do anything at the moment.
 Since the lot of you have apparently never received a piece of mail in your life, the mailbox will now glow when you have mail. Hopefully this will stop you from continually asking me "how do I check my email".

Performance

 Engine finally updated to 2019.4 LTS. Expect bugs. Report them.
 General performance improvement across the board, particularly for lower end devices.
 New video option "Fast Rendering Mode" is added and enabled by default. Gives about a 30%+ performance boost on it's own, for most setups. Play around with it and see.
 New video option "Toggle Post Processing Effects" is added and enabled by default. You can disable this for a massive performance boost, but the game will look even worse than it already does. Worth disabling if your framerate sucks, otherwise, leave it enabled.

Save System

Steam Cloud is now fully supported and enabled. Also, the save system has been slightly overhauled, now it is split into multiple elements.

 SaveFile2.es3 - The bulk of the savefile that contains almost everything.
 /saved-inventories/ - New directory that holds the inventories of various entities.
 /permaflags/ - New permanent directory that contains accomplishments that will carry over between saves.
Clearing the save file is now defined as deleting SaveFile2.es3 and /saved-inventories/

Bug Fixes/Miscellaneous 

 Some fonts have been replaced with better looking fonts.
 Laptop web browser look has been improved.
 Federal Agents now appropriately glow.
 VSync should no longer enable itself on it's own.
 Sliding on Cuckold's Car is no longer possible (RIP).
 Various rendering issues involving culled backfaces resolved.
 Video options menu overhauled, all broken options removed.
 Despite overwhelming light pollution from neighboring cities, you can see the stars and moon at night now.
 Improved cityscape backdrop for Boss' Office.
 Performance issues in Police Station resolved.
 Wife has gotten a new ankle tattoo.
 Achievement icons mostly updated.
 The Steam launch option "Configuration Menu (advanced)" has been removed.

Known Issues

 COVID Mask owners will need to go to the mailbox to retrieve a new mask. Please don't forget, there are some deadly new variants spreading.
 Cuckold doesn't wear any of his cosmetics while in Selfie Mode or certain transition scenes.
 Certain objects may show up as pink intermittently, please submit a bug report if you see any.
 Lighting in all areas gets weird after going to Police Station.
 Possible crash when changing video settings from title screen.

notes.title: CUCKOLD SIMULATOR 0.2.0 Update

The long awaited CUCKOLD SIMULATOR main story update is finally here! Where do I even begin?

Trading Cards, etc

Trading cards and community assets are LIVE! With this also comes badges, emoticons, and my favorite feature - backgrounds. I've prepared a set of nine professionally made backgrounds for you to show off your Cuckold Pride with. All of these can be purchased directly in the Points Shop, or crafted with cards.

View all available assets (except badge + trading cards, ofc) at https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/app/1141550

Price Increase

I firmly believe that the best way to reward a group of people is to punish everyone else. So, with that in mind, to thank my early supporters, I've increased the price of the game by $1.00. This is an unorthodox approach, sure, but I spit in the face of convention. Buy the game before I increase it again. 

New Content

 Three new areas added as part of main story.
 One new Funky Pop to find.
 Five new achievements added - Seven Hundo, Locked Up, Gang Stalked, Thrifty, and Baby Grabber

 In-game trophies added for the six of you who placed in the Cuck Souls Challenge. Find them in the dining room. (Still need to added proper rewards for this - maybe next patch).
 Forgot the rest, just play it.

Bug Fixes

 Day/Night transition improved.
 DeShawn dialog should be fixed.
 Mail notification icon fixed - should now only light up if there's unread mail.
 Mouse sensitivity in Anime Girl Genocide lowered.
 Night club glass rendering issue finally fixed.
 Various dialog tweaks.
 Various bug fixes.

Other

notes.title: CUCKOLD SIMULATOR 0.1.9 Update
notes.content:
So, full disclosure: I took a lot of lazy shortcuts when initially making the game because I never expected it to be as successful as it has been. It's taken some time to fix that up. The game obviously has had some performance related issues that currently aren't too bad, but bad enough that I can't add new content until I fix them... Because the game will eventually grind to a halt on average hardware. 

This patch should resolve that, and provide a base that's somewhat scalable. So if this all works out, the next patch will be new content. Resource loading has been completely overhauled, so the game should run better on low-end computers and, in general, have less crashes. As a downside, you may experience a slight loading time when transitioning zones now. Oh well. 

New Stuff

 New achievement added: 跑酷 
 Resource loading has been completely overhauled. 
 Pressing hotkeys will no longer interrupt your Reddit™ browsing experience.
 Various grammatical/spelling fixes.
 Various dialog changes.
 Controller support should be better in Cuck Souls (only tested with 360 controller)

Other New Stuff (nothing major, but will only appear in a new save)

 Deshawn will no longer menacingly stand inside the couch. 
 Dialog added to DeShawn after his prank.
 Music will no longer continually fade out after Night 7.
 Bedroom dialog on Day 8.

Known issue: If you logged out inside GameStart, you will now be falling into the void. It should teleport you back to the house after some time. Go grab a drink while you wait. All other areas should be fine.

Not a bug: 'Magic Rune Explosions' in Cuck Souls blocking bullets, I've decided I like this as it adds a needed disadvantage to being at a very far range.

notes.title: CUCK SOULS Patch 0.1.8
notes.content:
Some more changes. Fight is much more consistent now with all these changes. I am able to reliably do Flawless Victory now, so a lot of RNG has been removed if you're using optimal strategy. Accordingly, I have added three new achievements. We are going to push the limits of what can be done in this game. I am confident they can both be completed. 

Achievements
 Victory -> Pre-Nerf Victory: Killed the boss pre-nerf (no longer attainable).
 Post-Nerf Victory: You could only kill the boss post-nerf. Pathetic.
 myspacebarisbroken: Kill the boss without ever rolling.
 Godlike: Kill the boss without ever rolling or taking damage.

Boss
 Rotate mechanic changed: Now always between 90 and 270 degrees.
 Hitbox of wings moved back a bit so the two swords near her wings can reliably be shot
 Swords can be 2-shot from any distance now
 Health bar 'draining' visual effect removed due to it being buggy
 Reflect shield cooldown increased by 100ms

Player
 Gun damage changed to a flat 19, regardless of range (was 17-23)
 Shooting while rolling forward has been removed
 'Floatiness' of reticle greatly reduced (but still slighty present)
 Issue with end of reload animation preventing rolls has been resolved
 Issue with weapon shooting out multiple unintended bullets resolved
 Added terrible config menu on hotkey [F2], includes mouse sensitivity slider
 Added icons in the upper left to reflect whether the player is eligible for Flawless/No Rolls


Finally, to clarify, being hit interrupting your reload is NOT a bug.

notes.title: CUCK SOULS is Released!
notes.content:
Version 0.1.5 of CUCKOLD SIMULATOR brings along with it the highly anticipated game CUCK SOULS. Take on challenging [strike]bosses[/strike] boss and claim two new achievements - if you can.  I've thoroughly tested this. Don't complain about the balancing...

The first five people who kill the boss and attain the Victory or Flawless Victory achievement (with submitted video proof) will be forever immortalized into the CUCKOLD SIMULATOR universe by having their names as part of an in-game item. How exciting! Fire up those Wintendo Snitches and let's have some fun.

New Content
 CUCK SOULS game now fully functional. Buy it in Chinatown if you haven't already.
 Two new CUCK SOULS related achievements added: Victory and Flawless Victory.
 You can now quit out of Wintendo Snitch games by holding ESC.

notes.title: Performance/Optimization Update
notes.content:
CUCKOLD SIMULATOR Performance/Optimization patch has arrived! I have been hard at work optimizing meshes and lighting so you plebs on laptops can run the game. Being that I'm a Chad with a GTX 3080, performance is something I've never had to worry about... But we can not all be so lucky. This is for GPU/CPU performance only - load times are the same as they were before. Don't press anything while game is loading or it might crash!

Details:
Huge performance boost across all areas.
Lighting has been improved, so things will generally look better. Night club in particular saw biggest gains.
New graphical preset added: "Better Than Best"
I added something new but I forgot what it was already. As Deshawn would say, "idk just look around."

Bug Fixes:

Incorrect reflections at night should be resolved (except the car)
Fixed Genocide achievement
Made 'Trashman' achievement easier to get (no one has gotten it yet, wtf?)
If you have low-end hardware and were having issues running game before, I would appreciate if you'd let me know how the game is running now, either on here or discord. Thanks.


- Team SNEED

notes.title: Earlier Access Version 0.1.1 Released
notes.content:
CUCKOLD SIMULATOR Earlier Access version 0.1.1 has arrived! Featuring mostly bug fixes and a couple of new features. Performance/optimization patch will come at a later time. Until then, go out and buy a GTX 3080.

New Content: 
 Several bugs have been converted into features.
 5 new achievements added - some corresponding to the aforementioned [strike]bugs[/strike] features.  2 new Funky Pops added to the world for you to find.
 And most importantly - trash bins now have physics.

Bug Fixes: 
 Web browser is probably fixed now. If not, there's a disable option in the newly added menu (ESC->Game Options). Seems to be an antivirus issue - AVG is often mentioned - so you might want to deal with that on your end. It prevents Steam from properly reinstalling the game.
 Yuan display now works properly on 4:3
 You can no longer fall into oblivion below Chinatown. I think.
 Falling out of bounds in Wintendo Snitch games should be fixed. 
 Billiard ball collision detection improved.
 Camera will no longer clip through ceiling (as much) when jumping.
 Tyrone Jr. can now actually fall off the world - who will be the first to get the achievement?
 Anime girl will no longer brick your save after rejecting you.
 Some other stuff I forgot. 
Finally, I have a nice surprise for you regarding your current save file - more info in game! True cuckolds will get great enjoyment out of this!

Much Love,
Team SNEED
